assessment.reason: Read-only assessment of release/release-preparation.md sha256 db5e23ef (Result 5556) against source d5b08f04, constants 5a6b4064, obligations 7f84d69e, oracle 99b525d1 and admitted Testing 3339. Overall disposition: unmet. C1 UNMET: every oracle requiredArtifact is present except test-execution-result.json. The forbidden Node paths are absent and there is no target/ directory. The candidate's source citations are correct (S L16, L132, L549-559) and so are its parity citations (P sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 6.1). Four archive citations for current evidence point to superseded sections of test-run-archive.md (cfa3ca7f). [AR s6] is cited for R3339 but s6 covers f04a8190. [AR s4] is cited for R1444 but s4 covers 6eed. [AR s3] is cited for R358a and 2a40 but s3 covers repair 8b16. [AR s5] is cited for C1-C11 but s5 covers the eight earlier mutant runs. These facts are recorded in archive sections R.1-R.4. C2 MET: the candidate and parity (a7e0aaf1) report against all 28 stage meanings, which match obligations and the oracle. They record the source line L544 count of 26 as obsolete. C3 MET: all 8 sbt modules are typed Scala 2.13.12 with real Spark 3.5.1 DataFrame, Column and join logic and ScalaTest specs on LocalSpark local[2]. There is no substitute and no Node. C4 MET: R3339 meets all 9 predicates (exit 0, exact 8 modules and reports, 3/11/8 sources, 44 passes, 0 failures, 0 errors). Byte equality rests on digests: shasum of the 22 subject files equals each mutation baseline and restore digest, and the archive records that observation refs differ for identical bytes. I did not read the bodies of inventories 7d692ff or 5a3e3292. C5 MET, with one claim unverified: depth-proof-map 7648fe52 has 40 rows covering 8 requirements x 5 classes. Every cited identity exists in the specs and passed in 3339 stdout. Suites carry 8-hex prefixes and byte lengths, and the basis cites 3339 and 1444 and discloses that XML was not read. The claim that only the basis changed from 07a893f4 (20796 B to 19759 B) rests on 5556's own statement because the prior bytes are unavailable. C6 PARTLY UNMET: mutation-outcomes 98bd31a1 has 11 compiled cycles. Each exited 1, turned its own row's identity red and has restoreDigest equal to baselineDigest, which supports kills for rows 1, 3, 6, 8, 11, 16, 18, 21, 26 and 31. Rows 13, 23, 28, 33 and 38 have only incidental reds under other rows' mutants, which are not kills. Row 36 is only partly killed: UAT-ENG-NEG went red under C11 (d0629c) but U8 runner negative stayed green. greenFullSuiteBaselineRequired is not satisfied: 1444 and 3339 bracket the series but no green run sat between consecutive mutants, and the candidate correctly does not claim it. Failing names come from stdout reporter lines; the XML testcase-name bodies were never read, so the exact-XML-name rule is not established. The C8 mutant digest 5f6b089d...ad8600000 has an improbable trailing-zero run and appears only in mutation-outcomes.json, so it could not be checked against admitted inventory 1a6ac0f6. C7 MET: the archive and candidate keep dc18 (exit 1, 39 passes, 3 failures), historical 6eed and f04a, 358a red (only TOPO-INV), repair 2a40, green 1444, eleven red runs c5ed through d0629c, and current 3339. 70b27fec (equal to the C1 mutant, run by 358a) and 7ff8d8b7 (equal to the C7 mutant, run by dc18) are stated as unattributed with no author. C8 INDETERMINATE: build.sbt is plausibly sufficient for sbt clean assembly. It declares the sbt-assembly 2.3.1 plugin, root assembly delegated to cdme-engine with aggregate false, mainClass CdmeEngineRunner, the jar name and META-INF merge rules. Assembly was never observed, and offline resolution of the plugin and dependencies was never observed. C9 UNMET: test-execution-result.json is absent and no write root admits it. planSatisfied and assertedReturnValue ('data_mapper_full_sbt ok') were never observed as result fields. The candidate represents this honestly as open item O-3 and states that the U8 carrier testcase does not replace the artifact. C10 MET: repair schedule cb5ce696 section 7 records that predecessor 951bb0aa projected f5c713 with 'no repair' and that this projection is removed. Residual staleness remains: the schedule still names 6eed as the repaired green run, cites repair-application 0f972cb6 while the current file is be9cdd98, lists stages 26-28 as absent, and never mentions 358a, 2a40, 1444 or 3339. C11 MET: the candidate says 'Not release-ready' and claims no production release authority, release approval or UAT verdict. It states that ABG owns proof truth and that odd_glc only interprets the replay. Scope disclosure: I used only read-only commands (cat, sed, grep, shasum, python3 -I -c, one git check-ignore) and wrote no file, scratch file or redirection. Outside the worksite I listed the run directory and ran one content grep over the run directory. It matched only actor F_P archives under resources/archives, which I did not read further or use as authority. I granted no admission, acceptance, scope change or graph continuation. I did not perform independent installed readback or run sbt.
